about: Every default number the tools use, in the wire units (milli-SI, per-mille). A threshold is CHECK until it is calibrated on known-good and known-bad cases (calibration.json) and a qualified person approves it; a physical constant or a measured ratio from a cited source is RECORDED. Callers may override any threshold; the receipt says which source each value came from.

reference_height_mm.note: A convention for the reference human; scale factors are relative to it.

walk_froude_table.note: A stroll, the preferred walk (about 0.25) and the walk-run transition (about 0.5).

froude_min.note: A stroll. Below it a walk reads as slow motion; the rejected generated walks measured 7 and 16.

froude_max.note: The walk-run transition; a walk above it is not what people do.

stride_ratio_max.note: Measured stride over Alexander's predicted stride. Over-striding at a slow cadence is the slow-motion look.

duty_walk_min.note: Walking has double support, so each foot is down for at least half the cycle; running is below half.

slide_mean_mm_s.note: At the reference leg length; scaled by sqrt(leg / reference leg) (dynamic similarity).

derivative_window_ms.note: The span of the quadratic fit used to differentiate the COM; long enough to beat millimetre rounding, short enough to keep a human sway (under about 3 Hz).
